## The problem

What are you trying to do that the tool does not support today?

## The proposal

The command, flag or behaviour you have in mind. An example invocation
and its expected output help:

```sh
transpareo ...
```

## Alternatives

Other ways you considered, and why they fall short.

## Scope

- [ ] This concerns the command-line tool, the MCP server or the Go
      client in this repository.
- [ ] This needs a change in the Transpareo API itself. (The API lives in
      the platform and is not changed from this repository; the request
      will be forwarded to the platform team.)
